vendors.name: The Ummed Jodhpur Palace Resort & Spa
vendors.information:
The Ummed Jodhpur is a pleasant hotel that strives to provide commendable hospitality and service to their clients. The Ummed Jodhpur Palacial Hotel is located at Banar Road, Jodhpur. The venue offers an aura of opulence, signature hospitality and premium services to give a new meaning to the celebration plans from corporate events to pre/post wedding functions.They have a team that works with congeniality towards their clients and ensures the event they have planned turns out to the best of their expectations. Their aim is to provide you seamless service with best facilities that take care of all your minute details so that you can focus on only enjoying your special occasion.

 Services offered by The Ummed Jodhpur:

Their special provision of tastefully decorated banquets makes for an enticing venue for all your special occasions that are a mix of warm elegance and comfortable luxury with every facility at your service as you wish, Take a dive in the pool of elegance and comfort at The Ummed Jodhpur. Loaded with every beautiful element, it is a venue made right for your beautiful celebrations. Your marriage would be the most moment of your life right there in those amazing venue options.

 Space Available

Well, with The Ummed Jodhpur you need not worry about your wedding venue, it comes with a number of banquet options to celebrate your wedding and every function with ease and luxury. The venue has two indoor hall which can accommodate a maximum floating capacity of around 600 pax and offers a lush green lawn which can accommodate around 5000 pax. With culinary experts who can whip up some mouthwatering delicacies to choose from in both veg and non-veg food to their guests, there's no service that disappoints.

 Banquet Options:


Banquet Hall : It is an indoor banquet hall with a capacity of 300 seating and 600 on floating is a perfect banquet hall for all the ceremonies from haldi to Mehendi.

Banquet Hall and Lawn : It is The Lawn with a capacity of 300-6000 guests good to go for wedding rituals like engagement, wedding day and reception.

 Other services

The Ummed Jodhpur is arguably one of the best in the industry to cater to your personalized venue needs. Their spacious banquet & lawn give you ample space to house large groups of your guests. The venue is perfect for all pre-wedding and wedding nuptials.

 Location

Bannar Road, Jodhpur- 342027

 
From ravishing floral decorations to stunning lighting arrangements, they make sure that the venue and decorations are loved by everyone and are remembered long after the wedding is over. Diminishing your stress and endowing you the freedom to enjoy your wedding & all your ceremonies in best of the ways, they are a perfect single window to peep in.

 If you wish to book a venue that will hold some of the most memorable moments of your life, give them the chance to be the one for you. Elegant venue with such aesthetic values get booked really early, so don’t miss the chance and contact via WedMeGood
